name: wo-list
cmd: GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log | cut -c1-200; grep -E 'join (enumerated|exists)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-160; grep 'join caller failed' /tmp/err.log | tail -1 > /tmp/cf.txt; python3 -c "import json,re,sys; l=open('/tmp/cf.txt').read(); j=json.loads(l[l.index('{'):]); s=j['set'].split(' | '); sc=j['scored'].split(' | '); print('pres', j['pres'], 'set', len(s), 'scored>0', sum(1 for x in sc if not x.startswith('0:')), 'made-not-in-set', len(sc)); p=re.compile(r'VoteMsg\[64·x \+ y\] is 0 and 1 <= Votes\[64·y \+ x\]|1 <= Votes\[64·x \+ y\] and VoteMsg\[64·y \+ x\] is 0|1 <= Leader\[x\] and 1 <= VotingQuorum\[y\] and Votes\[64·x \+ y\] is 0|VotingQuorum\[y\] and 1 <= Leader\[x\] and Votes'); print('IN SET:', [x[-140:] for x in s if p.search(x)]); print('SCORED:', [x[:6]+x[-120:] for x in sc if p.search(x)]); print('TOP:', [x[:4]+x[-110:] for x in sorted(sc, key=lambda x: -int(x.split(':')[0]))[:12]])"
